title: Class Schedule Editor polish: stacking, size, class-list toggle, custom note editor
summary: Fixed the Class Schedule Editor rendering underneath the Settings modal instead of above it -- both used the same z-index, so whichever was later in the page (Settings) painted on top. It now uses a higher z-index.
The editor modal now takes almost the full screen instead of being capped at a fixed max width, so it feels less cramped.
Classes are now hidden by default in the editor grid (it was too busy with everything else already shown) -- a 'Show classes' toggle in the toolbar brings them back on request.
Editing a day's note now opens a proper modal with a title field and notes textarea, matching the same form used on the Day view, instead of two chained browser prompt() dialogs.
